connector.name: Hatchet MCP
connector.registryDescription: Observe and operate Hatchet workflows from an AI agent - runs, logs, trigger, cancel, replay.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package hatchet-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the elliotpadfield account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: HATCHET_CLIENT_TOKEN
env.description: Hatchet API token (a JWT). Encodes the server URL and tenant, so it is normally the only setting required.

env.name: HATCHET_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL. Self-hosters can point this at any Hatchet instance.

env.name: HATCHET_TENANT_ID
env.description: Override the tenant id decoded from the token.
